name: Ajit Sharma
aboutMeHeadline: I'm Ajit Sharma, a Technical Lead, experienced mobile application developer.
aboueMeDetails: With over 5 years of experience in mobile application development, including the last two years in a leadership role, I manage the full app development lifecycle from design and development to deployment and post-launch support. I specialize in Flutter, leading teams to develop high-quality, cross-platform applications for Android, iOS and web. I proficient in Agile methodologies, especially Scrum, I have successfully managed sprints, resolved blockers, and ensured timely project delivery using tools like JIRA, Azure Board, and Trello. In my leadership role, I have trained and mentored developers, helping them enhance their skills while ensuring that project timelines, budgets, and client expectations are met. I prioritise customer-centric solutions by aligning business requirements with technical outcomes, which is key to successful project delivery. Technically, I am skilled in architectural patterns like MVC and MVVM, and state management solutions such as Riverpod, Provider, GetX, and Bloc. I also have experience with integrating Firebase services, payment gateways, and managing CI/CD pipelines using Bitrise, CircleCI, and Fastlane..
